edus.text: Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh and greetings.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Let's start this morning Minister's Question Time by inviting Datuk Seri Haji 'Jamaluddin' bin Haji Alias, Jelebu.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: 'Jalaluddin' , Mr. Chairman is not 'Jamaludin' .
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: I'm afraid of people's mistakes later.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: Jalaluddin, forgive me.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: : Jalaluddin, yes.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias asked the Prime Minister to state about the latest approach and progress of the implementation of the Unity Government to holistically and effectively eradicate poverty in order to develop a country and civil society that will be an example in the region.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, thank you to Yang Berhormat Jelebu for being more positive in supporting the idea of shady poverty.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This is continuation of the initial steps,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: including the eKasih system collecting poverty databases under the ICU, Prime Minister's Department.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: As of March 15, 2023, the number identified was 123,243 heads of hard poor households had been registered.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Although I chose to put 130,000 people
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because it is possible that this number will increase.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Among the coordinated efforts, including the People's Income Initiative ( IPR ),
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: the Donation of Rahmah Cash ( STR ) to 400,000 people who are easily affected.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The entire incentive assistance subsidy in this entire framework reaches RM64 billion.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This includes the concept of Rahmah Fungery.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: A total of RM750 million has been allocated for the purpose of IPR with three initiatives that have been announced by the Minister of Economy recently, INTAN, INSAN and IKHSAN.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Then there are more besides the Farmers' Entrepreneur Initiative, the Food Entrepreneur Initiative and the Service Operator Initiative.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Some other steps include efforts to facilitate the appointment of workers, provide equipment and equipment
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and provide additional allowance assistance to participants.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The municipal council submitted the names of the participants so
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: that they can be treated directly.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: These are only some simplifying methods
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and STRs are given to almost 9 million recipients.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I develop this
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because it covers the amount called hard poverty.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Since all the departments and ministries involved are deployed, I am confident that we can handle the 130,000 heads of households this year as well, God willing.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Jelebu.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you His Excellency Tambun.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I looked into the answer from His Excellency Tambun earlier,
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: but what I understand is that the People's Income Initiative ( IPR ) is targeting 100,000.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: What was conveyed earlier, I am a bit confused
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: whether 125,000 is that the current IPR target achievement that can provide income to poor households
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and also B40 of RM2,000 per month?
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That's the first.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Secondly, my question is about performance or for screening to these IPR participants.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Since we are aware, applications through websites and portals to allow them to be included in this IPR group.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Filtering and leakage to ensure that those who have been selected are truly eligible to receive this help.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I agree with the remarks of Yang Berhormat Jelebu.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Because of the eKasih Report alone,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: before the IPR, there were several figures that were disputed by the setting.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I- we can not guarantee that 100 percent of the reported amount is truly entitled, including in the category of extreme poverty. '' 1010
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, the addition of this IPR program is because within one month, more than 22,000 people have already registered.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This is a development that for me is positive
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because when he registers,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: the check method is more effective.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So if the action is like that, like this, this March year the number is 123,000.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That's the number of studies done.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, I deliberately added to 130,000
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because I was worried, afraid that there would be some new numbers that were not included throughout this year.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So for this year, even though it is called 123,000, I say 130,000.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Yes, please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh.
edus.speaker: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]

edus.text: What is the target that has been placed by the government for every three months in the process of reducing poverty this year?
edus.speaker: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: For the first three months, namely April to June.
edus.speaker: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Both are July to September.
edus.speaker: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Finally is October to December.
edus.speaker: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: What mechanism is used to measure the achievement?
edus.speaker: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The additional allocation that I have announced is phase 1 of STR
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: which was implemented on January 17.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That involves 8.7 million recipients amounting to RM1.67 billion.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That's the first phase.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The second phase of STR was implemented on April 5, God willing, which is in the middle of Ramadan.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So if we look, as of March 28, an additional 574,886 new applications have been received.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So if we follow phase 1, phase 2 of April
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and I believe that in August or October we will give the following developments at the latest.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Meaning, the channel reaches directly for a large amount
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and makes it easier for us to solve this problem of extreme poverty.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This category of extreme poverty can be added twice.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: First, through STR and secondly, the IPR initiative.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Good.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Question number two, Honorable Masjid Tanah, Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin asked the Prime Minister to state the government's willingness to implement a recommendation from Transparency International Malaysia ( TI-M ) for the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission ( MACC ) to be placed under the jurisdiction of Parliament and no longer under the Prime Minister's Department to ensure that the agency's check and balance process is more independent and transparent thus increasing the level of trust and confidence in the public towards the MACC.
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: I see Yang Berhormat Masjid Tanah working hard now
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: because this time the fourth week was submitted,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: that's why I included it even though there are other questions by the opposition.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: However, due to his persistence, he repeated this question four times in a row.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: Well, follow the rules and legislation now,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: the MACC is an independent body.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: So that's why when I take over, I don't choose to change the MACC Chief Commissioner
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: who has been appointed by Yang Berhormat Pagoh not to create a perception that a new Prime Minister will appoint a new MACC Chief.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: Therefore I maintain.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: The provisions of the law now guarantee the freedom of the MACC
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: and are not subject to the instructions of the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: So the proposal presented to strengthen his position, then in the current rules there is a Special Committee on Corruption, the Anti-Corruption Advisory Board, the Complaints Committee, the Operations Evaluation Panel and the Consultation and Anti-Corruption Panel.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: So that's why,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: if it is raised
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: and there is indeed a study so far
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: because the former Prime Minister has also taken several initiatives to negotiate and weigh.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: So I have no problem weighing the Transparency International and others recommendations.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: I don't think we should make changes solely with this recommendation.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: We also have to be submitted to the Special Select Committee of Parliament to examine so that the MACC's capabilities will be improved
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: and there are no constraints and interventions that are feared will affect the implementation efforts to combat corruption which I consider to be systemic in our country.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: Thank you His Excellency Tambun.
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The country of His Excellency Tambun is so serious in eradicating corruption as in our Hope Deal page 37
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: regarding stating that the MACC Chief Commissioner's nomination needs to be reviewed by the bipartisan Parliamentary Special Select Committee to guarantee the appointment of a neutral candidate without protecting any party.
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So the question and coincidentally, it is heard that the MACC Chief Commissioner will end in a few months.
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: My question is, can the Honorable Prime Minister guarantee that the new appointment or extension of the Chief Commissioner's contract will now be brought to the Special Committee of Parliament immediately to be discussed?
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Otherwise, will this not give the impression that the Prime Minister's commitment to this reform agenda is no longer there,
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: even if the appointment is made by His Excellency Tambun as Prime Minister will further strengthen the people's assumption that there is a deal that is being arranged by the Prime Minister?
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Masjid Tanah.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: First, I would like to explain the appointment of the MACC Chief Commissioner by Yang Berhormat Pagoh, this one by Yang Berhormat Pagoh.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: It must be clear and certified as a person who is Wibawa and independent by Yang Berhormat Pagoh.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: The question now is,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: if there is a new appointment or extension,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: what is the new method imposed?
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: It depends on the progress made by Parliament.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: If the process mechanism as decided, proposed by TI and other bodies, is examined by of course the Attorney General's Department and government agencies.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: Then, transferred to the Select Committee and this process was time.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: So, I have no problem with the process at all
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: but the process should be respected.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Damansara.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I would like to make a reference to a statement
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: issued by number two from the MACC ( MACC ) yesterday, Ahmad Khusairi Yahya, which was widely reported in the media for the attention of His Excellency the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: He said, '' The level of corruption involving enforcement personnel '' Mr. Speaker, '' at the country's frontline is becoming chronic and worrisome ''.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: This is what is reported.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, although what is mentioned there brings special and specific reference to Immigration, I think Honorable Prime Minister, we know that this problem exists in all enforcement or implementation units that exist in this country, including MACC officers.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: The Honorable Prime Minister still remembers that when we were in the opposition, we had already raised the feeling that it was necessary for an independent investigation system or mechanism to be created to investigate complaints against especially MACC officers
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and also MACC top officials
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: when there was a complaint regarding abuse of power.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I heard what the Honorable Prime Minister mentioned earlier where we refer back to the committees that exist in the MACC for a specific purpose
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: but that's the problem.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Your Honor, we can not have a situation where when there is a complaint, the highest MACC ( MACC ) officers are investigated by the MACC itself
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because he is the person who leads the MACC and the MACC also has the right to investigate the police as well.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So, there we can see that pressure can be brought.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: There is no freedom
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and that's what we mentioned
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: when we were in the opposition before.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So the question now, how do we show or change the mechanism, where there is a complaint.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We still remember complaints made against the MACC chief at that time,
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: when investigated internally.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We say that is not correct, not enough
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because we don't know whether or not the investigation is what is called independent or independent.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So, my question to the Prime Minister this morning, move forward, what steps will be taken by the government to make sure that
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: if there is a complaint, especially regarding the highest MACC officers, which does exist a lot.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: How will we make sure that the investigation is carried out by the independent party
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and also the Parliament has the power to ask, inquire, investigate again, make questions regarding what is called the investigations
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: after the investigations have already been completed, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: If I get an answer, thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Please Your Excellency the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I still remember that stance did not budge.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That's why,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: when it comes to connection, not only MACC, police, immigration, customs, enforcement bodies,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: when there are allegations or any charges,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: then the body established is an internal body to investigate
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and this is disputed.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Therefore, for the police to be proposed by IPCMC
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: but that is questioned
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because why it is only directed at the police.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So, now I have asked the Attorney General to review the initial proposal so that there is a mechanism for all enforcement bodies.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: If there are special charges against MACC, immigration, customs, police officers,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: then there is an independent body,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: in the form of whether my commission is not yet certain,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: but there has already been instructions to the Attorney General's Department to submit a proposal so that these enforcement bodies do not investigate themselves
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: but there is another independent body that will investigate.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I don't think this is very difficult
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because there is an initial proposal.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I just want to emphasize here when the IPCMC issue arises, what the police are arguing about is why it is specifically aimed at them even though the problem should involve all enforcement agencies.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So, in my opinion this is a better proposal
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: which is an independent body that can take action to investigate, take action against all complaints or accusations against enforcement bodies.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This includes me re-explaining, police, MACC, customs, immigration and others related.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, you can add one question.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: An important issue.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Sorry.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: We have ...
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Just one, okay?
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Me, okay.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker,
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: thank you Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I congratulate the Prime Minister for continuing to fight corruption.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, I would like to suggest to the Prime Minister that we have to deal with the problem of corruption in its fundamentals, basically corruption at the political level, which is whether the Prime Minister wants to continue the proposal
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: to develop political funding laws, as happened to the Honorable Pagoh and the Honorable Tasek Gelugor?
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We should have political funding laws.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Maybe political funding by the state, political funding by the state.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I request an explanation and explanation from the Prime Minister,
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: when will this effort be implemented?
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Bayan Baru.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The initial proposal about political funding is still at the level of the Minister who is responsible for the legal issue.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Basically we agree,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: but because it was touched on the question of Yang Berhormat Pagoh earlier,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: it is not accurate.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This is not a matter of political funding.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That is the charge
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: if you look at it is related to the contract given.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: A party that gets money - now the law is missed.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, when it comes to the party getting money as a result of the contract given, it means that
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: if I give a contract to the company' A' ,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: the company' A' donates to my party, that is included in the category of corruption.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So it should be distinguished. [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This is because, many are confusing this issue
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: as if the party can accept it.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That's right.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: In the current state of law, the party can accept it,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: but if I approve or relate to approving one company, how many hundred million,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: then he donates to my party or my personal account or my personal company.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We want to say that the act of cruelty is unreasonable.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: It means we want to defend corruption.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This is the problem.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Okay, I invite the Honorable Mr. Chiew Choon Man, Miri.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Tuan Chiew Choon Man asked the Prime Minister to state the steps taken in an effort to achieve transitional justice at the same time uphold the rule of law in high-profile cases
edus.speaker: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: involving politicians such as Pandora Papers, Panama Papers, former Gombak Member of Parliament or politicians from any party.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please Your Excellency the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I can not answer
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: even if there is information about the previous actions where there are certain instructions.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, since I took over, I have taken a comprehensive approach.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Whoever has a case, who is involved, is an enforcement body, whether the Royal Malaysian Police or MACC refer to the Attorney General's Department, the Attorney General's Department decided to prosecute.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That's their decision and they should answer.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The question
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: associated for example with Pandora and Panama Papers, indeed everything is related, even though hundreds according to MACC were addressed to several big cases before.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, as the President is well aware, these cases involve people
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: who are capable, have large funds and have sophisticated ways.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: If we learn about what happened about Pandora Papers,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: there are for example companies in Singapore, accounting firms, PR firms that will try from the beginning to protect works and practices that are considered to be in conflict with the law.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: But the main thing is for us,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: what is the problem - the problem is a trend where political figures or businessmen run away so much money
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and are kept in offshore centers.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We can identify not only from the Panama Papers Report which is not absolute
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because it should be investigated
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: but must involve Bank Negara Malaysia, the Inland Revenue Board, the Trade Investigation Division, commercial crime and the IRB.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So, if these four agencies work that they continue to do.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The other case called Gombak Member of Parliament
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: is the action of the Attorney General's Department, not the actions of the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Miri.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you to the answer of His Excellency Tambun.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: My next question is in order to uphold the rule of law, is the government ready
edus.speaker: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and will in the near future implement the separation of the position
edus.speaker: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and role of the prosecutor from the Attorney General to strengthen the freedom of the prosecutor
edus.speaker: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and avoid any speculation or accusations that there is a selective prosecution of any politician and at the same time can prevent government institutions from being misused.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: His Excellency the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, this proposal has already been studied
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and there is a proposal to separate.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This matter is a bit complicated.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I remember it took time.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: In principle, many agree to be separated
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: but at the implementation stage we are careful
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because in terms of the impact of the financial implications
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: it is estimated to be more than RM300 million additional.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, I agree that it is not the main consideration.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This is because the main thing is to ensure the Attorney General's Department and the prosecution process which is more transparent and independent.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please Dear Rantau Panjang.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: [ Speak without using the speaker ]
edus.speaker: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: Mic, mic.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: For the short term under the 2024 Budget, various steps will continue to help the poor such as the Rahmah Cash Contribution ( STR ), the Rahmah Basic Contribution ( SARA ), subsidies to rice farmers and smallholders as well as repair projects involving rural infrastructure and the Poverty Eradication Program.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: Initiatives introduced under the Ministry of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living will also continue, such as the Rahmah Umbrella Initiative and direct sales from farms that offer affordable goods and services to consumers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: For the medium and long term strategy under the 12th Malaysia Plan Half-Term Review, people's income is increased through entrepreneurship programs, skills improvement and re-skill training as well as the provision of comprehensive social protection policies.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: These initiatives include programs such as the People's Income Initiative ( IPR ) implemented by the Ministry of Economy, which cover the provision of a complete ecosystem and in-kind assistance given to participants to support
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: and encourage them to carry out economic activities
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: to generate additional income sustainably.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: To date, a total of approximately 4,100 households have received a spillover of benefits from the implementation of this program.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: The government through the National Economic Action Council on November 6, 2023 has also agreed that all agencies identify households that can participate in the programs provided by the government within two months,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: before the end of 2023 and be absorbed into the programs offered accordingly.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: The government also agreed to consider giving special monthly cash assistance to households who are unable to generate income or unproductive groups to ensure they are out of extreme poverty.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: I ask for one more minute, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: The government realizes that the effectiveness of the poverty eradication efforts is also closely related to the main data sources used as references.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: Currently, the main data sources used are Household Income Surveys ( HIES ), National Poverty Data Bank ( eKasih ) and the Orang Asli Community Information Data Information Information System ( iDamak ) and each of them has certain weaknesses.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: Therefore, the government has decided to create a Main Database ( PADU ) which acts as a comprehensive database to help the government formulate development policies and programs including socioeconomic programs and eradicate poverty comprehensively without overlap.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: This PADU system is expected to be ready to be used in stages from January 2024.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: Finally, Mr. Speaker, in relation to poverty statistics.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Statistics regarding income and poverty levels obtained from the Household Income and Expenditure Survey, the latest HIES is for 2022
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: and the findings report was announced by the Ministry of Economy last July 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: Based on the report, the value of the National Poverty Line Income ( PGK ) for 2022, has increased to RM2,589 per household
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: compared to RM2,208 for 2019.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: Meanwhile, the value of the food PGK used to measure extreme poverty for 2022 is RM1,198 compared to RM1,169 for 2019.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: Based on the value of PGK 2022 at this national level, the findings are that the poverty incident is 6.2 percent covering 488,000 households.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: While the extreme poverty incident is 0.2 percent covering 18,000 households, reduced from an estimate of one percent in 2022.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: Based on this report as well, the gross household income of the middlemen ( median household income ) with permission, Mrs. Yang di-Pertua according to the three main races, is RM5,793 for bumiputera, RM8,167 for Chinese and RM6,627 for Indian families.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: Thank you Mr President.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Tampin.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Minister for the answer that was given a while ago.
edus.speaker: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Alhamdulillah, let us work together to make the government's wish to eradicate poverty
edus.speaker: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: and benefit the people.
edus.speaker: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: It is clear that this extreme poverty issue covers all races.
edus.speaker: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: However, the most people in the group are Malays and bumiputeras.
edus.speaker: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Regarding the classification of household income used by the government in drafting policies
edus.speaker: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: and determining the cash aid rate for example, it is indeed quite confusing.
edus.speaker: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: This is because the classification began to be emphasized through the 7th Malaysia Plan
edus.speaker: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: and does not take into account the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the people's economy.
edus.speaker: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: My question, Honorable Minister, does the ministry intend to review the categories of household income groups B40, M40, T20 and others
edus.speaker: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: and introduce some more detailed sub-income groups, according to each category to be more comprehensive and effective from the point of view of policy drafting and delivery of any form of assistance.
edus.speaker: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Thank you Deputy Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Thank you Tampin.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: if we look at the method of using the classification of B40, M40 and T20, this is a statistical method.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: Based on the household income study, it can be determined the distribution of households per family.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: So, the bottom of all, 40 percent and below there is an income line below that income is calculated as B40.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: The next 40 percent is M40 and T20.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: It is true since the 7th Malaysia Plan, the government's policy, especially those involving the granting of assistance, looks at these things.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: I think the community and also the House are aware that there are some weaknesses with approaches that use the income method simply
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: because it does not take into account other variables, including dependents in the family, including for example the location
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: because the cost of living varies by area, including also when we talk about petrol and diesel subsidies in a targeted manner, consideration of distance and so on.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: I think the previous difficulty is
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: because the database's infrastructure is not comprehensive
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: and does not allow the government to take into account other variables.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: So, that's why the previous approach is how good it is to look at income, measured to the B40, M40 income line, so assistance is given like that.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: That's why, the first action is that of course for us to create PADU and with the advancement of technology
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: and also data science that exists now, it allows the government to collect more information available.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: So, so far PADU has for each family household, PADU is expected to enable- to have variables of up to 120 more variables for each family household.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: This allows us to move from the previous approach according to income solely to the approach towards income spending can spend clean households.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: This means looking at income, then being rejected to dependents
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: and also taken into account other variables such as location, distance and so on, including property and that will - in the view of the government will give a fairer picture.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: When we already have a distribution based on this net spending income,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: then the method is the same.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: We will see this distribution for each family household and the government after that can ensure that the targeting of the aid is specific to certain groups and with more complex methods than the previous methods.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Mohd Isam bin Mohd Isa [Tampin]

edus.text: Thank you Mrs.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Long Range.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: Yes, thank you Mr. Speaker and thank you Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: My additional question is, to ensure that there are no poor people who drop out, so we expect a concrete mechanism to ensure that there are no these dropouts.
edus.speaker: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: I would like to know, what efforts have been made by the ministry for data whitening?
edus.speaker: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Because between the ministry and the ministry are quite contradictory.
edus.speaker: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: I see what was reported by the JPM ICU Program Performance Report, reporting until October 2023, there are still 106,213 KIR people who are extreme poor.
edus.speaker: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: While in what was mentioned earlier, in the budget report also mentioned that there are only 18,000 people.
edus.speaker: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: So, how will whitening be done, so that there are no dropouts
edus.speaker: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: and is there a mechanism that will be made to ensure appropriate measurements, especially for those in the city and outside the city
edus.speaker: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: because of different standard of living and cost of living?
edus.speaker: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Ask for an explanation.
edus.speaker: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Thank you Rantau Panjang.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: The actual whitening of government databases related to poverty, especially eKasih is actually a process that has been running every year.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: But as we already know, there is a challenge
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: because the current rules are, to get any help from the government,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: there must be a name in eKasih.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: So, of course the list in this eKasih that exists from 2007 will be some who do not want to leave.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: The same is the previous approach, including what the Ministry of Economy worked on, when we profiled how many families in eKasih are considered to be extreme poor for us to match the poverty eradication programs.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: On average, around 25 to 30 percent refused to be involved in any program
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: because for them, just give cash assistance, which involves generating income, he is not interested in all this.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: So, that's why apart from continuous whitening and I am well aware,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: ICU for example continues to mobilize government machinery to whiten.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: That's why in my information, as of September 2023, the list in eKasih has been cleaned now about 80,000 households from the 130 to 106
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: because as Rantau Panjang mentioned it is a matter of whitening.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: But we also know,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: this matter is dynamic
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: and the government can not focus 24 hours a day just to whiten it.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: There is a better method.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: A better method is to combine as much data in government departments.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: So, these actions are carried out in parallel,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: apart from moving whitening in eKasih carried out by the ICU, apart from mapping and profiling with permission, Mrs. Yang di-Pertua carried out by the Ministry of Economy to these extreme poor, coupled with a real-time cross-check.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: This will allow the whitening process to run better.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: When we start to take into account other economic variables for each household in PADU, I am confident that for the coming years we will get a more accurate poverty figure
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: and we can also get with the permission of the President, insight into every position of the poor family's household more accurately so that the form of assistance can be given more accurately.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: For example, the last one, Mrs. Yang di-Pertua – for example.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: Of the 100,000 people in eKasih, for example, the poor also have various forms.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: Some are poor
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: because they are indeed sick
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: and they no longer have the ability to work.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: This one needs to be given direct assistance by the government.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: We don't use to give them programs there, programs here because
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: they are bedridden, for example.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato' Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]

edus.text: I invite Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi, Kuala Kedah.
