edus.text: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi asked the Minister of Agriculture and Food Guarantee to state the immediate steps that have been taken strictly and holistically to deal with the issue of the sale of legal rice seeds that have been so stressful for the rice farmers recently which will certainly affect the rice production and the national rice self-sufficiency rate ( SSR ).
edus.speaker: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]
addressees: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]

edus.text: Thank you Deputy Speaker and thank you Member of Parliament for Kuala Kedah.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: For the information of Honorable Members, the current requirement for legal rice seeds is as much as 72,000 metric tons or 3.6 million kampit, 20 kilograms per kampit.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: The need for seeds for one hectare of rice paddy land, seven to 10 bags per hectare or 140 grams to 200 kilograms.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: The rice farmers enjoy an incentive of RM1.03 for each kilogram of legal rice seeds purchased from legal rice seed producers appointed by the government.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: In order to ensure that the supply of legal rice seeds is sufficient
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: and the price is under control, the ministry has taken several drastic steps-
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: First, closely monitor and control the approval of farms and laboratories against 12 legal rice seed producers based on the SOP set by departments and agencies
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: before legal rice seeds are sold to rice farmers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: Second, approving 532,325 legal rice seed kampit for use in the states of Kedah and Perlis with a production record of 89,723 seed kampit on 18 October, 151,200 kampit on 26 October, 79,142 seed kampit on 3 November and 112,000 seed kampit on 10 November.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: Third,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: expected on 17 November, will pass 50,000 kampit
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: where 31,000 kampit will be distributed to PPK MADA, the remaining 19,000 kampit will be distributed in the state of Perlis and outside the Kedah state granaries.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: Fourth, launched the Northern Zone Legal Rice Seed Operations Task Force starting 7 November 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: The implementation period of the OP BPS Task Force was held for two weeks from 7 November to 21 November.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: This is to ensure that all retailers sell according to the price set by the government and there is no element of hiding legal rice seeds.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: The current status on 7 November 2023, 20 licenses have already been withdrawn and on 16 November, two more licenses were withdrawn.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: The maximum price determination of legal rice seed sales for each 20 kilogram kampit, RM40 and retail sales place, RM45 starting 20 October 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: This price determination was made to avoid manipulation of the price of legal rice seeds in the field through unauthorized purchases.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: The sale of legal rice seeds packaged with special poisons for the previous CL220 rice variety should be sold separately.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: The price of legal rice seeds for the CL220 variety is at the maximum price of RM40 at the company's warehouse door and for the manufacturer, RM45 as retail price.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: I finish it.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: This is important for all rice farmers to hear.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: Legal rice seeds directly to farmers and farmers organizations dated 11 October 2023 have been canceled.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: In relation to the issue of retailers selling more than RM45 of rice seeds as stipulated, the government has taken immediate action with `` ( i )
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: withdrawing the legal rice seed sale license immediately.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: ( ii ) carry out intelligence and enforcement continuously to ensure that the price resolution is fully complied with by all parties; ( iii ) requesting rice farmers or any interested party to make a complaint to the Rice Rice Kawalselia Branch, State KPB Office through agencies such as the Department of Agriculture, the Agricultural Development Board ( MADA )
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: and the Farmers' Organization Board ( LPP );
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: and ( iv ) issue a retail license through the authority of the Director of KPB under the provisions of section 4 of the Rice and Rice Control Act 1994 to PPK and companies to distribute legal rice seeds directly to rice farmers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: For long-term measures, the government will implement a study to balance the price of rice purchases and the price of rice seeds.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: We will discuss this with the Ministry of Economy, the Ministry of Finance, KPDNK about the appropriate price coordination for all parties.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: Very soon, in the future.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: Because, everything has to be.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: Farmers have to win, wholesalers have to win, retailers have to win, consumers also have to win.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: This discussion needs to be done in a more organized manner, more so that all parties get benefits later.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]
addressees: Dr. Ahmad Fakhruddin bin Fakhrurazi [Kuala Kedah]

edus.text: Kuala Kedah.

addressees: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]

addressees: Menteri Pertanian dan Keterjaminan Makanan [Datuk Seri Haji Mohamad bin Sabu]

edus.text: God willing, now we act by using anything including fast track for the preparation of this rice seed.

edus.text: I invite Mr. Oscar Ling Chai Yew, Sibu.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Mr. Oscar Ling Chai Yew asked the Minister of Transport to state the extent
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: to which the number of flights and passenger handling for airports in Malaysia has returned to the level
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: before COVID-19 and what is the achievement of domestic flight time accuracy ( on time performance ) for 2022 - 2023 as well as regulatory measures taken to protect users from delays and flight cancellations.
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: Mrs. Yang di-Pertua, for the information of Honorable Members, the recovery level of the number of flights between January and October 2023 is at a rate of 74.1 percent or 381,475 flights compared to 514,896 flights for the same period in 2019.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: For the purpose of passenger handling, the airports in Malaysia have handled a total of 109,428,322 passengers for 2019.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: In 2022, this number has decreased to 54.8 million passengers or 50.1 percent compared to the number of passengers recorded in 2019.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: As of September 2023, the airports in Malaysia have handled a total of 62.8 million passengers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: The government aims to increase the number of passengers this year by 87.8 million passengers which is 80.6 percent compared to the number of passengers recorded in 2019.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: The number of passengers is expected to return to the pre-pandemic level next year.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: The overall recovery level of the number of passengers is at a rate of 77.5 percent between January and September 2023 compared to the same period in 2019.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: The best recovery is domestic passengers at a rate of 84.4 percent,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: followed by Asian passengers at 77.5 percent and 63.4 percent for passengers of other international destinations.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Regarding time accuracy achievements or on time performance.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: For domestic flights, Malaysian airlines have recorded a 79 percent achievement for the third quarter of 2023
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: compared to 82 percent in the second quarter of 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: The details of time accuracy achievements for the third quarter of 2023 are as follows- For SKS Airways - 95 percent;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: MASwings - 93 percent;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Batik Air - 82 percent;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Firefly - 77 percent;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Malaysia Airlines - 74 percent; and AirAsia - 74 percent.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: In addition, MAVCOM is also in the process of determining performance status for accuracy achievements and flight cancellation rates for Malaysian airlines.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: This process is estimated to be completed in the first quarter of 2024.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Sibu.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: [ Stands up ]
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Panglima Mohd Shafie bin Apdal [Semporna]

edus.text: I - Mr. Speaker, I do not know if the government and the Minister are satisfied with the airline's on-time performance so far.
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Imagine, an employee who is late reports work a day, two days every week.
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: [ Stands up ]
edus.speaker: Dato' Azman bin Nasrudin [Padang Serai]

edus.text: Of course, they have to be scolded and warned from their employers.
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: So, Malaysia Airlines and AirAsia, earlier we saw that their performance of 26 percent is one quarter of the total domestic flight is not on time.
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: It's more than 30 minutes late
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: and also why is it now 30 minutes late?
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: So, my question about this on-time problem, will the government give a warning and fine this airline, which fails to meet this time?
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: So, I ask for an explanation from the ministry.
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: First of all Mr. Speaker, the flight delay has various factors.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: There are things that are beyond the control of the airline.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Weather, for example.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: How to control the weather?
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: If the weather is bad,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: how can the plane fly?
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: So, that needs to be understood.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: [ Stands up ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Abdul Latiff bin Abdul Rahman [Kuala Krai]

edus.text: It's not that airlines intentionally delay their flights,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: but I agree that there are many things that we need to improve, which we need to improve.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Not only airlines but also airports, also air traffic management.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Also, we need to know that this air traffic management is also not under the airline, that's the first.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Both, in terms of improving and also improving the achievements of airlines in this on-time performance, the government or through MAVCOM will also take action
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: if the airline fails to comply with the Malaysian aviation user protection code.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: [ Stands up ]
edus.speaker: Dato’ Haji Mohd Suhaimi bin Haji Abdullah [Langkawi]

edus.text: This is something that we will find an approach to, how to set a target on time performance and if they can't achieve that on time performance,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: then there is a possibility that something action will be taken.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: However, as I said, there are various factors that need to be taken into account instead of just one factor, which is the airline.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Indeed, we will always monitor
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: and we will also request that these airlines can manage their schedule better.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Kuala Krai.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Abdul Latiff bin Abdul Rahman [Kuala Krai]

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran ask the Prime Minister to state the total amount spent by the government on promotional and publicity work in publicizing the government's achievements through all mass media platforms including print media, digital media and also television media throughout the year since 2020 until now.
edus.speaker: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh and greetings.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Tan Sri Yang di-Pertua, since 2020 until 2022
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: yes, the government has spent on promotion, at that time Pagoh and the government system of RM700 million.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Ads, promotions, publicity.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This means that almost more than RM500 million was spent during Pagoh and the rest by Bera.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: But Bera did not spend that much because there was an excess.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That's why in 2023, I have no allocation, other than continuing the contract
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: made during Bera.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So, RM700 million or approximately in the early stages of RM300 million a year.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That for me, violates rules and governance and excessiveness.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Therefore, I have ordered expenses from next year –
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because this year I only took the existing contract, continuing what Bera had agreed to.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Meaning, 2023 has no allocation and for 2024, I have ordered that the Ministry of Finance not approve more than RM100 million, instead of the amount of around RM300 million that was spent earlier.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This, while we consider the explanation of the explanation necessary.

addressees: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]

addressees: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]

edus.text: So, of course we are first, disagreeing with the way made by the United States.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]

edus.text: Both, he did not influence our policies and decisions and throughout the last night, I contacted several friends countries and Islamic countries that gave the same stance, that we do not recognize yes.

addressees: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
