edus.text: Mrs. Vivian Wong Shir Yee asked the Minister of Transport to state what the Malaysian Aviation Commission's ( MAVCOM ) long-term plan is to overcome the high price of airfare between the Peninsula and Sabah, especially during the festive season.
edus.speaker: Puan Vivian Wong Shir Yee [Sandakan]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Peace be upon you, good morning and greetings of unity.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, as a government based on Madani Malaysia, the Ministry of Transport takes seriously the people's complaints and complaints about the high price of flight ticket fares and beyond their capabilities, especially during the festive season.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: For the information of Yang Berhormat Sandakan, the setting of domestic air fares by national airlines is based on the rationalization of the domestic air service sector in 2006.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: In this regard, the Cabinet has decided that the national airlines that provide domestic air services are given freedom in determining network coverage, flight frequency and fare rates that want to be offered based on market demand.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: The Ministry of Transport through MAVCOM will determine
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: and continue monitoring the price of flight tickets for all domestic flight routes,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: including routes between Peninsular Malaysia and Sabah and Sarawak.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: In this connection, the airline has implemented a special initiative to offer flight tickets at low prices for example,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: AirAsia Aviation Group Limited has provided 52 additional flights on fixed low fares from Kuala Lumpur and Johor Bahru to six destinations namely Kota Kinabalu and Tawau in Sabah as well as Kuching, Sibu, Bintulu and Miri in Sarawak from January 17 to January 30, 2023 last in conjunction with the Chinese New Year celebration.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: AirAsia also provides 62 additional flights
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: which are an additional 11,400 seats on low fares but from Kuala Lumpur and Johor Bahru to seven destinations namely Kota Kinabalu, Sandakan and Tawau in Sabah as well as Kuching, Sibu, Bintulu and Miri in Sarawak from April 19 to April 21, 2023 and April 28 to April 30, 2023 in conjunction with the upcoming Hari Raya Aidilfitri celebration,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: which is at a fixed fare price for flights from the Peninsula to Sarawak at a price of RM199 and from the Peninsula to Sabah at a price of RM249.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: I understand that after two days of launch, more than 3,000 tickets have already been sold.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: The routes that are very popular, especially between Kuala Lumpur to Tawau and Kuala Lumpur to Sandakan, are almost sold out.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: I would also like to take this opportunity Mr. Speaker, to answer the Honorable Sri Aman as I promised yesterday,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: which raised the issue of flight delay frequency.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: For the information of the Honorable Sri Aman, the Ministry of Transport through the Malaysian Aviation Commission ( MAVCOM ) on January 5, 2023 reminded all airlines to strengthen the management of flight delays and cancellations,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: aimed at improving communication to passengers and providing care and needs as outlined in the Malaysian Aviation Consumer Protection Code ( Malaysian Aviation Consumer Protection Code ) 2016.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: If the airline fails to comply with MACPC,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: MAVCOM can impose a financial penalty of an amount not exceeding RM200,000 and a second or subsequent non-compliance, a ten-time amount of the financial penalty imposed for the first non-compliance.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: From 2018 to January 2023, MAVCOM has imposed a penalty of RM4.72 million for the airline's failure to comply with various offenses under MACPC.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Airlines that cancel flights due to factors under the control of airlines such as unsatisfactory technical or passenger capacity cause the flight to be delayed or canceled
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: are subject to offering replacement payments within 30 days or change of route as provided in MACPC.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: As part of the ongoing efforts to improve the consumer protection code,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: MAVCOM is currently in the process of improving MACPC based on user feedback
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: and also important teachings that occur during the COVID-19 pandemic.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: The improvement includes increased consumer protection in cases that have never happened during this pandemic.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: MAVCOM estimates that the improvement process will be completed in the second quarter of 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Additional question, Honorable Sandakan.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you for the answer from the Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Puan Vivian Wong Shir Yee [Sandakan]

edus.text: My additional question is whether the ministry will introduce flight packages at a reasonable price to students from Sabah and Sarawak
edus.speaker: Puan Vivian Wong Shir Yee [Sandakan]

edus.text: to overcome the problem of airline fares during the semester break and consideration to open a new route from Penang or Johor to Sandakan
edus.speaker: Puan Vivian Wong Shir Yee [Sandakan]

edus.text: to reduce the cost of transit for Sandakan residents.
edus.speaker: Puan Vivian Wong Shir Yee [Sandakan]

edus.text: Because of this attachment that I printed last week, [ While showing a document ] the price to return to Sandakan can reach RM1,400 for one way.
edus.speaker: Puan Vivian Wong Shir Yee [Sandakan]

edus.text: So, I request the Honorable Minister to answer.
edus.speaker: Puan Vivian Wong Shir Yee [Sandakan]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Puan Vivian Wong Shir Yee [Sandakan]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Sandakan.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Indeed, we know that we are trying to work on various initiatives for students.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: At this point, Malaysia Airlines Berhad offers a special program for students, Mhexplorer,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: where students who are registered with the program are eligible to enjoy a discount of up to 30 percent of the price of flight tickets in addition to other benefits such as an additional luggage allowance of 10 kilograms and a special offer for family members and fellow students.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: That's what MHexplorer is currently implementing.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Meanwhile, for the initiative of other airlines, we are indeed trying to discuss with other companies.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Indeed, we know many other airlines that have already been operating.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: In a moment, after this I will also meet with MyAirline.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: I will also raise it to look at flights that have not been operational yet, for example as suggested between Penang and Sabah and Sarawak.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Maybe there are in Kota Kinabalu,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: but in Sandakan there are less.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: I know that the Kuala Lumpur-Sandakan route in terms of service is somewhat reduced.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: We are trying to increase capacity for other airlines.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Thank you Mr President.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Kota Belud, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Puan Isnaraissah Munirah binti Majilis @ Fakharudy [Kota Belud]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Additional question next to the opposition, Your Honor ...
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Padang Besar.
edus.speaker: Tuan Rushdan bin Rusmi [Padang Besar]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Dear Padang Besar.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Honorable Minister, is there any plan from the ministry to increase flights from the West Coast to the East Coast
edus.speaker: Tuan Rushdan bin Rusmi [Padang Besar]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: since so far there is one flight from Penang to the East Coast
edus.speaker: Tuan Rushdan bin Rusmi [Padang Besar]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: and it is quite limited.
edus.speaker: Tuan Rushdan bin Rusmi [Padang Besar]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Right now we have to transit to Kuala Lumpur
edus.speaker: Tuan Rushdan bin Rusmi [Padang Besar]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: before going to the East Coast.
edus.speaker: Tuan Rushdan bin Rusmi [Padang Besar]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: That's all.
edus.speaker: Tuan Rushdan bin Rusmi [Padang Besar]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: For your information, the Ministry of Transport has no obstacles for any airline
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: because this is all related to commercial consideration,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: if there is a demand
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: and the airlines are encouraged.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: We practice in terms of points to points there is no obstacle.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: It does not necessarily transit in Kuala Lumpur,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: whether from Penang directly wants to go to Kota Bharu,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: go to Kuala Terengganu and so on, the Ministry of Transport welcomes.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: However, only these airlines often look at the capacity
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: and also market demand.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: If there is a high market demand,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: of course they will open the route
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: but I understand that sometimes there should be incentives and so on.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: I can suggest to the Honorable that for example in the states on the East Coast,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: the state governments certainly also have a Tourism Action Committee.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Through the Tourism Action Committee,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: it can provide some incentives to airlines so
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: that they have direct flights from new destinations such as Penang to Kuala Terengganu or Penang to Kota Bharu.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: So, if there is an incentive for airlines,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: I am sure they will start the route.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Additional questions.
edus.speaker: Puan Isnaraissah Munirah binti Majilis @ Fakharudy [Kota Belud]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Next is the second MQT question, Mr. Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj, Honorable Segamat.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj asked the Minister of Economy to state how the People's Income Initiative ( IPR ) can help B40 households and extreme poverty generate income
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: and how the Ministry of Economy can ensure that 100,000 extreme poverty can be involved in this IPR.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: How much income projections can the participants generate according to the three initiatives under the IPR namely INTAN, INSAN and IKHSAN.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh and good morning.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker and thank you Honorable Segamat.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: The Ministry of Economy launched the People's Income Initiative ( IPR ) shortly after the budget which is on 26 February 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Under the IPR, a total of three pilot initiatives as mentioned earlier have been introduced namely the Farmers' Entrepreneur Initiative ( INTAN ), the Food Entrepreneur Initiative ( INSAN ) or the Service Operator Initiative ( IKHSAN ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: This initiative involves cooperation between the government, the recipients, the people and the community as well as strategic partners through a concept that we call with permission, a whole-of-nation approach.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: It crosses the value chain ecosystem in an effort to deal with poverty and inequality and at the same time generates the people's income in line with our plans under the Twelfth Malaysia Plan.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Since this program was launched, the Ministry of Economy has received various encouraging feedback and responses through applications made through the IPR website
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: which is ipr.epu.gov.my which is specifically developed as a platform not only for recipients to register but also for representatives of the people, communities and neighbors to take that task to register so
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: that we have a larger list for us to check with existing government databases.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: In order to ensure that the participants who apply are eligible,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: a cross-check will be made with the eKasih data system
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: which is the list of extreme poor recipients that we already have
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: and also the data of the recipients of the Rahmah Cash Donation.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: The Ministry of Economy also cooperates with the state government and local authorities
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: in identifying and nominating the eligible target groups and meeting the criteria set.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: After this I have a meeting with all PBT leaders from all over the country so
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: that we speed up this matter to go down to the lower level throughout the country.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: So far, the number of applications in about a week and a half is about to enter two weeks,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: which is around 24,000 people.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: That number increases from one day to one day.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: So, God willing,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: in terms of that target, the target we set is that according to the official government statistics is 135 extreme poor families.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: With us expanding it also through offers to the B40 group, we hope to be able to expand the ecosystem so
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: that it is not handed over only to extreme poor groups for them to work on these initiatives
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: but assisted in an ecosystem
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: that also has participants from the B40 group.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: This is because in the ministry's research so far, this B40 group has a little more ability to work
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: and that will be able to help the recipients from extreme poor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: One more minute, Mr. Speaker?
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Please.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: So, as I mentioned earlier, the first component in the implementation of the IPR is INTAN
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: which aims to increase the income of extreme poor and B40 as well
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: as reduce dependence on the importation of food raw materials.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: There are ingredients that we should be able to work on ourselves.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: For example, import chili, ginger, corn and sugarcane.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: We actually have the ability and suitability.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: At the initial stage, the focus is on the strategic crop that I mentioned earlier and of course
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: when it is more mature,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: then it can be adapted to local demand
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: because the method of these agribusiness entrepreneurs is to use the fertigation method
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: which allows the crop cycle to be changed quickly according to local needs.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: So far, the government has identified
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: and obtained around 800 acres of Federal Government land throughout the country dedicated to this program.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: In the last week, Mr. Speaker, we have also started to receive response from agencies in certain states through their respective agricultural progress corporation that will participate.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: So, the land bank, God willing, will be expanded from time to time.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: The Ministry of Economy also in a strategic collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture and Food Guarantee will provide assistance in the form of providing sites, infrastructure and agricultural training, marketing and sales within the 24 months.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: So, so far, based on the economics we provide in this framework, the income projections obtained from the sales of chili, for example, for half an acre for each recipient through this fertigation method is up to RM2,000 per month within the 24-month period.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: A little more.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: The second component is what is often talked about is INSAN,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: which is food entrepreneurs through vending machines.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: The current situation is that for people to start doing business through vending machines, the cost becomes too high
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: because the vending machine industry in this country is still, with permission, capital intensive.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Meaning, those who want to work have to pay up to RM20,000 to RM30,000 to get the machine.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: So, this also creates a problem for the vending machine industry
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: which is actually important for the use of IOT in our economy
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: because of the large fund requirements.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: So, the method taken by the ministry is to ensure that this matter is not necessary.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: There is no need for a deposit, there is no need to buy.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: It's just that the government distributes aid to recipients in the form of rental of the machine every month between RM700 to RM800 per month for a period of 24 months.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: From the pilot projects that we have launched in the last two weeks,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: so far daily income and daily sales will reach up to RM2,500 per month.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: The third is through the Service Operator Initiative ( IKHSAN ) which has a two-point goal.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: First, we want to make sure that the forms of services that are in the government system first.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: For example, cleaning, taking care of public facilities such as public toilets
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: and will be expanded to other facilities.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: This matter does not need to be through the contractor
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: because when appointing a contractor, the contractor has to take the margin and the margin causes the salary received by the employee
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: to be low.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Through IKHSAN, we ensure that these tasks are given directly to the recipients from extreme poor and B40.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Because, in fact, the ability of government agencies and local authorities varies by place.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Therefore, the government through this IPR will increase so
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: that the net income of the recipients who take over the duties of this service is as much as RM2,000 per month within 24 months.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: So, God willing, the government is confident that the efforts implemented will help attract the participation of more target groups - and the ecosystem -
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: because those who become recipients will be required to join cooperatives among themselves in each area through this process and cooperatives
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: that also involve the participation of local stakeholders.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: This means that retirees, professionals, those who want to do charity.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: So, this will help train these recipients so
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: that after 24 months, they already have a form of income generation activity that is limited.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Thank you Mr President.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Honorable Segamat, additional question.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you to the Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: I welcome this People's Income Initiative
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: because we can see an initiative that can drive economic growth as well
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: as reduce the income gap.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: My additional question is how this People's Income Initiative becomes a stepping stone for other ministries other than the Ministry of Agriculture earlier as well as the ministry-related company agencies as a sustainable economic platform for rural people, especially unemployed or young people and youth to engage in rural economic activities that can make the source of income active and progressive?
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Segamat.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: It is true that programs in this form are also cultivated in other ministries.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: For example, the Ministry of Agriculture has worked hard,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: the Ministry of Entrepreneur Development is also available from small traders and so on.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: The approach I mentioned earlier, with permission, is also the one whole-nation approach that is used at the government level among ministries.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Meaning, when this program, for example agri-entrepreneurs ( INTAN ), it is true that it focuses on agriculture
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: and because this template is provided
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: which covers all chains from the preparation of participants to the sale, that's why the ministry can also cooperate with the ministry of agriculture
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: because the ministry of agriculture provides training and expertise support.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: This expertise is provided by farmers' organizations according to their respective areas.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: The same thing, for example, will happen with the Ministry of Entrepreneur Development and Cooperatives
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: because they will be classified in local cooperatives.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: So through this one whole-nation approach, it will encourage cooperation and even competition from other ministries and agencies
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: because IPR, God willing, will provide interested workforce who really know that this is the template.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: This is because before, one of the difficulties of such programs was to get participants.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: To get participants to work on agri-program, to get participants, for example, to join small cooperatives.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: So, through this IPR, we hope that when the door is opened
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: and it is welcomed well as we have found so far, cooperation between the Ministry of Economy and other ministries can not only focus on three IPR templates
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: but these recipients can also be channeled to programs that are ongoing by other ministries that if before there was a little difficulty to get participation.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Thank you Mr President.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Maran.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Recently in the budget presentation,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: the Honorable Prime Minister mentioned that he will focus on this extreme poverty.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: In my understanding, it means that there is no longer there,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: there is no continuation.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: There is no more extreme poverty.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Honorable Minister, actually our experience, I have been a government official.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: I have been in Parliament for four terms.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Various programs have been carried out.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Malaysia's plan is twelfth now.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Indeed, the government's wish, our wish in this Parliament is indeed good enough
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: and the Honorable as the new Minister of the economy is indeed beautiful, very beautiful.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: `` 1030 If possible today, tomorrow the extreme poverty will run out of everything.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: But do we know that there are many other factors that cause this poverty to happen.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Even if we plan well
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: but the recipients of our program are not ready ...
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Your Honor, this is not a debate.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: Question.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: So of course it will affect this.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Good, Your Honor, for a moment.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: My question - Your Honor, be patient.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: I am also used to this Parliament.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: [ Laughs ]
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: Your Honor, my question is, does Your Honor know or identify what factors can thwart the government's goals
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: and plans to oppress these extreme poor?
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: Because I want to mention one, we once planned to zero drugs in 2015,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: today drugs are getting worse.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: Your Honor, question.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: Not a proposal ...
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: Please, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: thank you Honorable Maran.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: I welcome the memory and suggestion from Yang Berhormat Maran, even from all these honorable Members of the House
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: because the effort to deal with the extreme poor is not a matter of politics.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: This is a trust and responsibility that needs to be shouldered not only by the government,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: but requires the help and cooperation of all parties.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: So I want to comment quickly Mr. Speaker, two things.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: First, regarding the opaque that has always been used as a topic of debate so far.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: My view and our plan at the Ministry of Economy when we mention the opaque is that we want to ensure that the group that has become the recipient enters this program.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: After 24 months, they leave the poverty line
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: and already have the ability to generate income
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: and not fall back into the extreme poor group.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: So when we talk about opaque, we need a program that really has the survival of income generation for this family so
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: that the leap they have will continue.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: That's the difference after we look at various programs
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: and we also reflect on the previous implementations.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: This is because it is often also a difficult situation as Yang Berhormat Maran mentioned earlier, that if the aid is given directly in the form of cash or assistance like Yang Amat Berhormat Tambun mentioned which is dependency syndrome, with permission.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: Indeed, we can eliminate extreme poor according to statistics within one day.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: This is because we have 136,000 families in our eKasih database.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: To get out of extreme poor,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: it means that this extreme poor income must be RM1,500 per month
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: because the extreme poverty line is approximately RM1,200.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: Can be done every month.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: However, that also means that they will continue to be in a system that depends on continuous assistance
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: and that does not solve the problem.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: So when we mention the government's plan is to create the ecosystem so that from time to time like Yang Berhormat Maran and we all know, of course the poverty line for example, will continue to rise.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: Now we are finalizing ...
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: Honorable Minister, speed up.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: ... In terms of income for 2022, of course the extreme poverty line increased from RM1,200,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: he may increase to RM1,400.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: So when it goes up to RM1,400,
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: there will be a new group.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: But at least, those who have gone through this process will no longer fall there.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: So, programs like this that target extreme poverty in the future will continue to those new groups
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: and we will not continue to help those who have to rely on government intervention.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Dr. Haji Ismail bin Hj. Abd Muttalib [Maran]

edus.text: Thank you Mr President.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Let's proceed to the third question, Honorable Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse, Tebrau.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs to state what the Malaysian Government's stance is on the current situation in Myanmar where a legitimate and elected government through the democratic vote process was overthrown by the military junta through coup measures in February 2021.
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I would like to thank the Honorable Tebrau for the questions raised.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, for the information of this honorable House, Malaysia's stance on Myanmar's issue is clear and consistent.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Malaysia will continue to stand for not to recognize the June government in Myanmar following the military coup in the country on 1 February 2021.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Malaysia is really very concerned about the prolonged political and humanitarian crisis in Myanmar which does not show any signs of abating.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: The implementation of ASEAN Five Articles Consensus or with permission, the Five-Point Consensus ( 5PC ) has not yet reached a satisfactory level.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: However, Malaysia will continue its existing efforts to help Myanmar achieve a solution to the conflict that is happening in the country.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Malaysia believes that the situation in Myanmar needs to be addressed through ASEAN in line with the ASEAN Charter and the principles of ASEAN Centrality
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: since it is a regional problem that threatens ASEAN's security, peace, progress and prosperity.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: The 32nd ASEAN Coordinating Council ( ACC ) Coordination Council and the Settlement of ASEAN Foreign Ministers in Jakarta have met on February 3 and 4.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: The meeting has agreed with the 5PC implementation plan focused on ASEAN efforts
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: to create a conducive environment for a clear dialogue involving all stakeholders in Myanmar.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: The plan is expected to contribute towards facilitating the distribution of humanitarian aid to all Myanmar citizens without discrimination.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: In this connection, Malaysia will continue to work closely with other ASEAN member countries in an effort to help Myanmar achieve a peaceful and sustainable solution.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: It is important to develop the full and effective implementation of ASEAN Five Articles Consensus or 5PC that has been adopted by ASEAN leaders in April 2021.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: In this regard, Malaysia continues to support the efforts carried out by ASEAN under Indonesia's accruing and through its special envoy, the Foreign Minister,
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: as agreed by ASEAN at the settlement of the Foreign Minister in Jakarta.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: In full, Malaysia's stance on this issue remains unchanged.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Malaysia will also continue to respect the decisions of ASEAN leaders
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: regarding ASEAN's efforts in dealing with related issues in Myanmar.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Dear Tebrau, additional question.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: I sympathize with the people of Myanmar.
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: This is because I and millions of Malaysians have also experienced a very bitter experience
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: when the government elected by the people through the ballot box was brought down when our friends in PH at that time betrayed the people's mandate and left PH ...
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Your Honor, Your Honor, this is a session of asking not discussing.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Yes.
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Myanmar has a military coup, we go through a political coup.
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Question.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: There is, there is.
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: In a moment.
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: But it's okay, humans plan, but God determines.
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Don't go around around.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sabri bin Azit [Jerai]

edus.text: Fortunately, in the recent GE, the people still returned to support ...
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: [ Speaker off ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: Your Honor, I will give you space.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Otherwise, I will ask you to sit down,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: I will share it here.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Question.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: So, I hope
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: I want to ask the Honorable Minister, can this government be willing with permission, take the lead to restore democracy in Myanmar
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: by holding more dialogue or engagement or whether Malaysia or ASEAN have economic sanctions against Myanmar as a pressure to restore democracy in Myanmar?
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: That's the question, please Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: As I explained a moment ago in the answer,
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Malaysia will not stop to continue engagement efforts, with permission, together with ASEAN friends.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: The issue, in the context of Myanmar, can not only be addressed by Malaysia,
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: it requires ASEAN agreement
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: because it involves ASEAN issues,
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: and in this context, we need the agreement I mentioned in the context of this `` ASEAN centrality '' very very important.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: We understand that the issue facing is very very complicated, whose idea will allow other powers to come in later - to intervene
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: and it will create an atmosphere of what we call a flashpoint in the area and will make the Southeast Asian region unsafe.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Therefore, Malaysia will not be disappointed with what is happening.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: We will continue our efforts
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: until a final solution can be implemented including as I mentioned in the answer a moment ago -
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: which involves inclusive efforts, involving all parties who are there
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: and also parties who oppose the government there.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Kuala Selangor.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Dr. Dzulkefly bin Ahmad [Kuala Selangor]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Pasir Mas.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Kuala Selangor.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Dr. Dzulkefly bin Ahmad [Kuala Selangor]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Pasir Mas.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: I think the question from Yang Berhormat Tebrau earlier actually insulted the Honorable Minister
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: and also Mr. Yang di-Pertua at once.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Your Honor, question.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Honorable Minister, I agree with the stance taken by Malaysia as a country of moderate size,
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: which is very dependent on peace and order at the international level.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: We can not express views or positions that are too harsh and different from other countries.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: It's just that, in the view of the Honorable Minister, will it also affect our bilateral relations with Myanmar in the long term,
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: and also the welfare of our people who are there,
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: because until one day, we will definitely have to deal with a government that we do not have recognition by taking the example of the `` Taliban Government '' in Afghanistan.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Thank you for the question of Yang Berhormat Pasir Mas.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: I would like to clarify that our relationship with the Government of Myanmar, although in the current situation, it is quite difficult,
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: but we still put, continue our embassy there through our charge, in our efforts
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: to ensure that the discussion process and also engagement that I mentioned earlier, can continue from time to time.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: This is because we do not want any things that happen in that country
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: because Myanmar is still one of the ASEAN Members - whether they want it or not, what happens there will have an impact in our country.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: That's why the government made a decision, despite the major crisis that happened there,
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: the government continued our embassy to function, to inform us about the things that happened and the developments that happened in Myanmar.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Dato Sri Diraja Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, another question from Kuala Selangor.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Dr. Dzulkefly bin Ahmad [Kuala Selangor]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: This question is very important.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Dr. Dzulkefly bin Ahmad [Kuala Selangor]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Please forgive me, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Dzulkefly bin Ahmad [Kuala Selangor]

edus.text: ASEAN questions are very important Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Dr. Dzulkefly bin Ahmad [Kuala Selangor]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Sorry.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Dzulkefly bin Ahmad [Kuala Selangor]

edus.text: Minister's Question Time has ended.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Your Honor, the session for Minister's Question Time is now over today.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: We will continue our next agenda.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Just a moment.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Just to celebrate a little more - as I mentioned earlier, as many as 14 questions from the government, as many as three questions from the opposition.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: I request that the opposition increase their views on Rule 24A. We don't want to be biased.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Okay, the Secretary will continue.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: `` According to Meeting Rule 12 ( 1 ),
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I beg to propose that the Meeting today will not be adjourned at 1.00pm
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: and will convene directly until it is finished to be debated
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: and decided DR 4/2023 Financial Bill 2023;
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: DR 3/2023 Extraordinary Profit Levy ( Authorization ) Bill 2023; DR 7/2023 Mandatory Death Penalty Repelling Bill 2023; and DR 8/2023 Lifelong Penalty and Punishment Review Bill ( Federal Court Temporary Jurisdiction ) 2023 as at No. 1 to 4 in the Order of Business of the Meeting and Proposals today.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: After that, the Meeting will be adjourned until 10.00am on Tuesday, April 4, 2023. ''
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I beg your support.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Honorable members, now I present the problem to the Council for decision.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: The problem is that the motion as presented earlier must be approved.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: [ Motion presented to be decided; and approved ]
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, Standing Order 18 ( 1 ),
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: `` Any Member other than the Minister can stand in his place
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: and ask for permission to negotiate a specific matter
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: regarding the interests of the public
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: who want to be expedited by reading the text of the motion
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: approved by Mr. Yang di-Pertua ''.
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I have received a reply from the Speaker's Office of the Dewan Rakyat
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: regarding the emergency motion that I sent last Friday.
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Unfortunately, this morning I saw that the motion was rejected with the reason
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: that the Honorable Deputy Minister of Finance and the Honorable Minister of Finance had already explained the matter
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: regarding the targeted withdrawal of this EPF.
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: However, I have received many views
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: and also complaints or concerns from the people
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: that the explanations and comments from both the Honorable Minister of Finance and the Honorable Deputy Minister of Finance have recently not satisfied them.
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: So allow us Mr. Speaker, for us to debate this matter today,
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: there are two days left before we end the Parliament session today.
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: It is possible if this motion is considered so
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: that it can bring the interests of the public
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: who really need the production of targeted EPF this time.
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]

edus.text: Please consider Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Dear Machang, the decision has been made by Mr. Yang di-Pertua and in accordance with Meeting Rule 43,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]

edus.text: Mr. Yang di-Pertua's decision is final.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]

edus.text: If you are not satisfied,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]

edus.text: please make a proposal again.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I also use Meeting Rule 43.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]

edus.text: No, Point of Order 18 ( 1 ).
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I also brought the same motion
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: but I have not received a letter of rejection or acceptance.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: However, the word that the President's decision often mentions,
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: `` if you are not satisfied,
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: bring a motion ''.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: When can we discuss the motion?
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Tomorrow is the end day, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Let's meet with Mr. Speaker later.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: So, secondly.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Like a written answer, five days.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Five days, meaning after Parliament is over we get an answer.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: So Mr. Speaker, I suggest that this motion be debated
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: because the people want this matter to be debated.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: The Honorable members on the other side also agree that this motion should be debated.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: [ Honorable Members of the Opposition rise ]
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: Dear Arau, this is the decision of Mr. Yang di-Pertua.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: If you are not satisfied,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: I have already said that you can meet with Mr. Yang di-Pertua later
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: or make a proposal again.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: Okay, I can not rule over.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Hamzah bin Zainudin [Larut]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Yes.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Let's see how many of the Members of Parliament here want this problem to be discussed.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Hamzah bin Zainudin [Larut]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: This is a really desperate problem.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Hamzah bin Zainudin [Larut]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Hamzah bin Zainudin [Larut]

edus.text: Let's see, there are already many people who want this matter to be brought and debated in Parliament,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Hamzah bin Zainudin [Larut]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: so that some are willing to walk from Johor to the palace until today.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Hamzah bin Zainudin [Larut]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Hamzah bin Zainudin [Larut]

edus.text: Is the government no longer aware that the people down there are waiting for the decision we will make today, Mr. Speaker?
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Hamzah bin Zainudin [Larut]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: So, that's why we want it to be allowed for us to debate this issue.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Hamzah bin Zainudin [Larut]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: That's what we want, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Hamzah bin Zainudin [Larut]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Yes, that's correct.
edus.speaker: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I have already said that the President's decision is final.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: If you are not satisfied,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: you can meet Mr. Speaker later.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I can not make a ruling now
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: because that is the President's decision.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Datuk Awang bin Hashim [Pendang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: This is the interests of the people.
edus.speaker: Datuk Awang bin Hashim [Pendang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I have already said, I know.
